lines: Our eyes make tears when we are sad.
Our eyes also make tears when we laugh.
We blink our eyes a lot.
When we blink, tears spread in our eyes.
They keep our eyes wet and clean.
We sometimes get dust in our eyes.
Then, our eyes make more tears.
When we are sad or happy, we cry tears.
Tears are good for our eyes, so don't be afraid to cry.
body.text: Our eyes make tears when we are sad. Our eyes also make tears when we laugh. Tears show our feelings. They also protect our eyes. Let's see how tears work. We blink our eyes a lot. When we blink, tears spread in our eyes. They keep our eyes wet and clean. We sometimes get dust in our eyes. Then, our eyes make more tears. The tears wash it away. When we are sad or happy, we cry tears. These tears help us relax. Tears are good for our eyes, so don't be afraid to cry.
